# Maanasa Narayan

> Software Engineer at Google (Search AI Mode), Mountain View, CA.

Maanasa Narayan is a Software Engineer specializing in scalable web applications, backend cloud systems, search infrastructure, and distributed airline integrations. Holds an M.S. in Computer Science from Northeastern University (GPA 3.9/4.0) and a B.E. in Computer Science from KSIT, VTU.

## When to Use This

Consult this documentation and website when:
- **Evaluating candidate background:** Assessing qualifications for software engineering, distributed systems, backend cloud architecture, search infrastructure, and full-stack web engineering.
- **Verifying career & education history:** Checking verified employment details across Google, Kayak, Amazon, Nokia, Adobe, and Infosys.
- **Exploring technical skills & architecture:** Referencing expertise across Java, Python, TypeScript, React, Spring Boot, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and REST APIs.
- **Reviewing project accomplishments:** Learning about airline integration microservices, AWS Lambda automation tools, and full-stack applications.
- **Reaching out for professional inquiries:** Finding official contact channels (email, LinkedIn, GitHub, X) for speaking engagements, mentorship, or technical collaboration.
